title: Exhaustive Tailwind Plus Marketing catalog

story.need: select every licensed Marketing UI pattern and variant from a governed catalog
story.outcome: complete sites and faithful migrations can be composed without inventing layouts from first principles

scope: Catalog all 133 section variants, 31 site-element variants, five not-found variants, and ten page recipes
Separate page blocks, site chrome, system screens, and page recipes by their actual content role
Expose stable family and variant identifiers to admin, inline editing, previews, public rendering, and MCP
Provide responsive accessible renderers and valid starter data for every selectable page-block family
nonGoals: Treating composed page examples as indivisible blocks
Arbitrary HTML or arbitrary CSS classes
dataRequirements: Every catalog entry has a stable family, variant ID, label, role, and source classification
Variant IDs remain independent of licensed source paths
Every page-block family uses structured validated content with stable repeater IDs
Recipes contain ordered block-family and variant references rather than copied example content
permissions: Anonymous visitors read published variants only
Authenticated editors may select variants in drafts
MCP writers use the same schemas and content service as browser authors

then: all 179 patterns have exactly one stable catalog entry
the catalog reports 133 sections, 31 elements, five system treatments, and ten recipes
no licensed source file is shipped or documented

acceptanceCriteria.when: a supported page-block family and variant is selected
then: starter data passes the shared schema
the variant is retained through draft, preview, publish, and read-back
the public renderer exposes the stable family and variant identifiers

acceptanceCriteria.when: it is selected during page creation
then: the recipe expands into editable structured blocks
authors may subsequently reorder, replace, and edit every generated block

fixtures: one page containing every page-block family
verification: Schema and default-data test for every family and variant
Admin and MCP catalog contract tests
